note: ja_standard, en_standard and zh joined two senses (またと also). Reduced each to the single sense 'this side / near side'.

changes.def_en_standard: this side; near side — the side closer to oneself
changes.def_zh_standard: 这边；近处 —— 靠近自己的一侧

note: Japanese definitions reuse むかえる (the word itself) and the simple one is not child register. Rewrote both without the word.

changes.def_ja_simple: くるひとにあいに、でかけていくこと。
changes.def_ja_standard: 来る人や客を、出向いて待ち受け、あいさつすること。

note: zh simple and standard copy the Japanese word 天皇 verbatim, which the gloss gate rejects. Replaced with natural Chinese equivalents.

changes.def_zh_standard: 日本君主；日本皇帝 —— 日本国的象征
